resources.name: Plane-wave DFT code with PBE functional and DFT+U capability (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Must support plane-wave basis, PAW/USPP, DFT+U, and NEB. VASP is also acceptable if a licensed copy is available.

resources.name: LOBSTER (Local Orbital Basis Suite Towards Electronic-Structure Reconstruction)

access.notes: Required to compute projected COHP (pCOHP) and integrated COHP (ICOHP) from plane-wave DFT wavefunctions.

resources.name: Bader charge analysis code (Henkelman et al.)

access.notes: Used to compute Bader atomic charges on the adsorbed CH₄ molecule.

resources.name: Crystal structures of IrO₂, CrO₂, and β-PtO₂ in rutile and distorted rutile forms

access.notes: Initial bulk structures for DFT optimization.
